Published

President Donald Trump won a second term in 2024 on four central pledges: seal the border, avoid new foreign wars, fix the economy and clean up Washington. Nineteen months into his term, polling shows him underwater on the four of them. [...] Quinnipiac's July 2026 poll found 34 percent approved of Trump's handling of the economy overall, versus 62 percent who disapproved. Nearly half of voters in that poll, 49 percent, said they were financially worse off than a year earlier.
